title: Instagram Profile Risk Pattern Catalog

categories.name: Identity & Verification Patterns
patterns: Uses celebrity photos but different username
Bio claims CEO or Founder with no company link
Bio claims government or NGO identity without proof
Multiple authority emojis to fake credibility
Fake fan account pretending to be real account
Name mismatch between username and bio identity
Profile picture inconsistent with account theme
Bio claims awards or recognition not referenced elsewhere

categories.name: Follower Network Patterns
patterns: Very high followers with very low engagement
Followers spike suddenly in short time
High followers but posts very few

categories.name: Posting Behavior Patterns
patterns: Long inactivity followed by posting burst

categories.name: Caption & Language Patterns
patterns: Urgency language like act now or last chance

categories.name: Engagement Manipulation Patterns
patterns: Comment sections filled with DM sent
Comment farming prompts like type YES
Like counts extremely low for follower size
Identical emoji comments from many users
Sudden engagement spikes on specific posts
Engagement only from small repeated group

categories.name: Content Style Patterns
patterns: Stock photos pretending to be personal life
Crypto charts used as authority signals

categories.name: Giveaway & Promotion Patterns
patterns: Send 1 ETH get 2 ETH back style scams
Asking users to tag many friends
Asking users to send wallet addresses
Winner will be announced tomorrow repeatedly
Giveaway posts but no winner announcement

categories.name: Account Lifecycle Patterns
patterns: Old content unrelated to current niche
Sudden shift from memes to investment

top20_power_signals: Credential transfer language in bio captions comments
Risky external links and unknown domains
Official claim without verification or proof
Repurposing via old post deletion and bio username changes
Giveaway scam pattern with wallet requests
Funnel path to Telegram WhatsApp Discord

robust_missing_data_safe.critical_rule: Missing signals are unknown evidence and do not increase risk by themselves
robust_missing_data_safe.trust_tier_rule: If verified and large established history and no hard fraud then force risk <= 0.30 and trust tier Strong Legit

clean_variable_weight_structure.core: R = w1*I + w2*N + w3*B + w4*C + w5*E + w6*L + w7*T + w8*D

real_world_breakers: Verified institutional accounts with missing timestamps should not be forced to uncertain trust
Huge meme pages with low engagement need account-type baseline priors
New legitimate startups must not be over-penalized for low history
Hacked verified accounts need abrupt behavior-shift detection
Unverified local government or NGO pages need external proof consistency checks
Private accounts need missing-data caps not risk inflation
Campaign spikes must be normalized against event windows
Multilingual scam content needs language-aware lexicons
